news.title: A Kentucky man with a meat allergy was craving a burger. So he got into ostrich farming - AP News

weekly_forecast: This week, the ostrich farming craze reaches new heights as tick-bite victims nationwide demand their beef alternatives. Expect a viral TikTok trend of people attempting to ride ostriches like rodeo bulls, resulting in at least three minor injuries and one very confused bird. Meanwhile, the beef industry will panic-release a statement claiming they’ve always been 'allergy-friendly,' but no one will care because ostriches are just more interesting.
